categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: LED display control systems, video processing systems, and cloud-based information publishing and management systems. These segments provide comprehensive solutions for LED display, ultra-high-definition video applications, and cloud-based display management. The products serve various downstream end markets including entertainment, command centers, sports events, exhibitions, advertising, virtual shooting, celebrations, TV broadcasting, information dissemination, creative displays, smart cities, and conference activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core video and display control algorithms, leveraging advanced hardware and software integration. Key technologies include high-precision full grayscale brightness and color calibration, micro-pitch LED display image enhancement, multi-layer and multi-screen synchronized video processing, intelligent image color processing based on human visual characteristics, super-resolution reconstruction, and high-precision fault identification for display clusters. The company also develops MLED core detection equipment and ASIC chips to support high-quality, scalable MLED manufacturing and consumer applications. R&D follows an IPD integrated product development process emphasizing customer value and platformization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves over 4,000 global customers, including leading LED display manufacturers like Leyard, Unilumin, and Absen, as well as commercial display leaders such as BOE and Nationstar. Its products are widely used in professional and commercial markets, including large-scale events (e.g., Olympics, World Cup), entertainment venues, command centers, advertising, smart city infrastructure, and emerging fields like virtual shooting and home theaters. The company targets both domestic and international markets with a focus on high-value downstream applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Xi'an, China, with a global presence including subsidiaries in Europe (Novastar Technology Europe B.V.), North America (Novastar North America Inc.), and Southeast Asia (Visionstar Tech Co., Ltd. in Thailand). Its sales are primarily domestic (approximately 81% of revenue) with significant and growing overseas revenue (about 19%), reflecting expanding international market penetration. The company maintains a global service network centered in Xi'an, Beijing, and Shenzhen, covering major domestic cities and key overseas regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the LED display industry supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of LED display control hardware, video processing equipment, and cloud-based management software. It provides critical components and integrated solutions to downstream LED display manufacturers and system integrators. The company also develops specialized testing and repair equipment for MLED production, supporting upstream manufacturing quality and efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology-driven innovation with sustained high R&D investment (over 16% of revenue). Strategic R&D focuses include advancing MLED technologies, ultra-high-definition video processing (4K, 8K, and pre-research on 16K), integrated ASIC chip development, and cloud-based display management platforms. The company aims to enhance product performance, expand application scenarios, and maintain leadership in video and display control algorithms. Talent acquisition and management system improvements support these innovation goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of LED display control systems, video processing systems, and cloud-based information publishing and management systems. The company employs a direct sales model complemented by distribution channels. Sales are recognized at the point of control transfer, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. Additional revenue streams include after-sales services and government subsidies related to R&D and industry support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading high-tech provider of video and display control solutions in China, with growing global influence. Major competitors include international firms like Barco, which have earlier and broader global footprints, and domestic companies such as Chunzhong Technology and Calatech, which are rapidly advancing in technology and scale. The company leverages its strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product portfolio, and strategic partnerships with industry leaders to enhance its competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 3.28 billion, representing a 7.38% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 593 million, slightly down by 2.31%. The company’s total assets grew by over 30% to RMB 5.44 billion, and shareholders’ equity increased by 70% to RMB 3.66 billion. The company maintains a robust growth trajectory supported by expanding domestic and international sales, increased R&D investment, and successful capital market activities including a recent IPO and share repurchases.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, technologically advanced, and integrated video and display control solutions that enhance visual experience and operational efficiency. Its products feature superior image quality, high integration, low power consumption, and scalability, particularly in emerging MLED and ultra-high-definition video markets. The company’s comprehensive full-chain solutions—from display control hardware to cloud-based management—offer customers cost-effective, reliable, and innovative services. Its strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and proven performance in major global events differentiate it from competitors.
